status_note: Authoritative runtime-vs-development source payload policy. Filename retains the legacy '_draft' suffix for tool/test path stability (release_manifest_audit.py, stage_release_assets.py, tests).
hard_rules: Release artifacts must not include PyQt6 or legacy_desktop.
Repository source/development files may include Electron build scripts, but generated Electron and portable release outputs belong only to the distribution plane.
Release artifacts must not include user-downloaded runtime assets by default.
Release artifacts must not include local wildcard files by default; runtime wildcards belong under user-data/wildcards.

Release artifacts may include reviewed small bootstrap filters under data/*.txt and data/taglist/*.json; bulk operational data under data/tags/** must be initialized or downloaded into runtime user data.
Writable runtime state must resolve through core.runtime_paths.
Release staging should be produced through tools/stage_release_assets.py or an equivalent manifest-driven process.
Manifest-selected release source payload must pass tools/check_release_source_payload.py before staging or packaging.
Electron backend resources should be staged under resources/naia-backend before Electron packaging.
Staged backend resources must pass tools/smoke_staged_backend.py before packaged-app validation.
Staged backend resources must pass tools/smoke_remote_web_contract.py for non-destructive Remote Web feature-surface validation.
Staged release directories must include RELEASE_MANIFEST.json and CHECKSUMS.sha256 from tools/write_release_metadata.py.
Staged release directories must pass tools/check_release_preflight.py before packaging or distribution.
Backend runtime strategy must pass tools/check_backend_runtime_strategy.py before backend binary work.
Project layout policy must pass tools/check_project_layout_policy.py before filesystem reorganization or Electron boundary changes.
Runtime distribution tracks must pass tools/check_runtime_distribution_tracks.py before changing clone-user launchers, Electron packaging, or Remote Web ownership.
Project layout round completion must pass tools/check_project_layout_round_completion.py before declaring a layout/runtime boundary plan complete.
Project cleanup candidates must pass tools/check_project_cleanup_candidates.py before destructive source cleanup.
Remote Web feature contract must pass tools/check_remote_web_feature_contract.py before desktop-code deletion or packaged-app validation.
Runtime write policy must pass tools/check_runtime_write_policy.py before desktop-code deletion or packaged-app validation.
Runtime asset classification must pass tools/check_runtime_asset_classification.py before desktop-code deletion or packaged-app validation.
Headless core boundary must pass tools/check_headless_core_boundary.py before desktop-code deletion or packaged-app validation.
Staged release directories must pass tools/release_manifest_audit.py before distribution.
Large data movement requires reviewed candidate lists before execution.
